title: Merchants with limited purses
summary: DMs can give a shop a purse of its own: selling to the shop is paid from it, buying from it fills it, and restocking tops it up again.
items: The sell form says before you confirm when the merchant can't afford an item, and a sale they can't cover is refused whole, never half sold. Sell & split works the same way.
DMs can set the most a shop pays for one item, and let a shop buy items outside its usual categories at a lower rate.
Players see only that a merchant can't afford something unless the DM chooses to show the purse.
Shops without a purse work exactly as before.
